last.verdict: Chemicals growth and lower debt costs lifted profit, but Print, once the turnaround story, shrank 7% and earned almost nothing.

takeaways.label: Print turned sour
takeaways.text: Print revenue fell 7% to $165 million, after growing 10% last quarter. Its operational EBITDA (a core profit measure) dropped to $1 million from $8 million.

takeaways.label: Chemicals carry the load
takeaways.text: Advanced Materials & Chemicals revenue rose 21% to $99 million, and its operational EBITDA rose to $21 million from $16 million. It now supplies nearly all of Kodak's segment profit.

takeaways.label: Profit gain came from debt
takeaways.text: Net income rose to $21 million from $13 million, helped by interest expense falling to $3 million from $18 million. Operational EBITDA rose only $2 million, to $31 million.

takeaways.label: Cash rebuilt, costs creeping
takeaways.text: Cash rose $27 million to $317 million on $25 million of operating cash flow. Stock-based pay jumped to $8 million from $1 million, pushing up overhead costs.

history.verdict: Kodak's fourth straight year-over-year improvement, with gross profit up 61% and net income of $17 million, now has less debt behind it.

takeaways.label: Margins jumped
takeaways.text: Gross margin rose to 26% from 19% as higher prices and volume outran pricier silver and aluminum. Operational EBITDA reached $36 million, up from $9 million.

takeaways.label: Chemicals led growth
takeaways.text: Advanced Materials & Chemicals revenue rose 40% to $105 million and its operational EBITDA nearly tripled to $22 million. Print grew 10% and swung to an $8 million profit.

takeaways.label: Debt sharply reduced
takeaways.text: Kodak repaid $101 million of term loans and cut interest expense by $9 million. Management said total debt to EBITDA is 1x, versus 23x a year earlier.

takeaways.label: Cash and pension caveats
takeaways.text: Cash fell $47 million to $290 million as inventory rose $37 million on silver and aluminum. Pension income is expected to stay below last year's level through 2026.
